body:
## Issue Addressed

  The pre-Gloas builder circuit breaker (`BeaconChain::is_healthy`) never applied to Gloas block production. `chain_health` was computed on the Gloas path but never read, so gossip and direct builder bids were used regardless of chain health. Its
  rules also don't map well onto ePBS: builder failures show up as blocks whose payloads never land rather than as missed slots, and the finalization rule doesn't make sense because the chain can finalize without any payloads.

  ## Proposed Changes

  Adds a `CircuitBreaker` (`beacon_node/beacon_chain/src/circuit_breaker.rs`), owned by `BeaconChain` and used only after Gloas. The pre-Gloas `is_healthy` is unchanged.

  **Skip rules count missed payloads**

  - A skip is a slot whose beacon block landed but whose execution payload was never applied. It is read from the production state's `block_roots` and `execution_payload_availability`. Slots with no beacon block are not counted, since they are a proposer failure rather than a builder failure.
  - `--builder-fallback-skips`: consecutive blocks with missing payloads before the proposal slot. Empty slots are skipped over.
  - `--builder-fallback-skips-per-epoch`: missing payloads in the last `SLOTS_PER_EPOCH` slots, as a rolling window like pre-Gloas.
  - Both rules are evaluated on the state being extended, so they stay consistent under re-orgs, including proposer re-orgs.
  - When a rule trips, direct builders are not queried and the local build is preferred. A gossip bid already in the cache still competes, ranked below the local build, so it is only used if the local build fails.

  **Builder bans**

  - In `per_slot_task`, after fork choice runs, the builder behind the previous slot's head block is banned if:
    - the block carried an external bid;
    - its payload was never received and the PTC majority didn't vote it timely;
    - its weight is at least the builder payment quorum.
  - Bans last `--builder-fallback-ban-slots` slots (new flag; default and minimum `SLOTS_PER_EPOCH`).
  - Each ban is tied to the offending block root. When filtering bids, a ban only applies if that block is an ancestor of the chain being extended, so re-orging away from it lifts the ban and re-orging back reapplies it. A second miss adds a separate entry rather than extending the first.
  - Banned builders are dropped even as the fallback when the breaker has tripped.

  **Other changes**

  - `ProtoNode::payload_timeliness` is split so the PTC vote tally is available without the local payload-received gate. It is exposed as `ForkChoice::ptc_votes_payload_timely`.
  - `BidCandidate` gets a `demoted` flag as the first element of its rank key. Like `min_bid`, it is ranked rather than filtered.
  - The Gloas production path no longer calls `is_healthy`. `BuilderParams` is replaced by the slot in `get_execution_payload_gloas` and `prepare_execution_payload`.
  - New metrics: trips by condition, bans, live ban entries, and filtered bids.
  - `--builder-fallback-disable-checks` bypasses both the skip rules and the bans.
  - Book and CLI docs are updated.

  ## Additional Info

  - Bans are kept in memory and don't survive a restart.
  - Detection only looks at the head at the slot boundary. A withheld payload on a fork that only becomes canonical later isn't detected.
  - Weight is measured at the start of the next slot, so the builder's view when it decides whether to reveal can differ from ours. If the block reached quorum by our check but the builder saw it as weak, the builder is banned. That ban lifts if the
  block is re-orged out.
  - The quorum uses fork choice's justified balances, the same units as the block's weight, rather than the head state's total active balance.
  - A self-built block with a missing payload counts toward the skip rules, because the state can't distinguish it from a builder miss. It never triggers a ban.
  - Tests:
    - unit tests in `circuit_breaker.rs` and `bid_selection.rs`;
    - Gloas integration tests in `beacon_node/beacon_chain/tests/circuit_breaker.rs`, covering bans, the PTC guard, a re-org lifting a ban, both skip rules, and the fallback when the local build fails.
  - The test harness gains `genesis_builders`, `make_signed_gossip_bid`, `make_block_with_gossip_bid` and `try_make_gloas_block_with_envelope_on`.
title: Gloas builder circuit breaker
